senses.gloss: m.(b. h. אִטֵּר, v. Hebr. Dict.), sub. יד ימינו one whose right hand is tied up or unfit for labor; left-handed.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bekhorot 5:8">Tosef. Bekh. V, 8</cite> <he>א׳ בין בידיו וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Bekhorot 45b:4">Bekh. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ בין ביד וכ׳</he> one either left-handed or left-legged (v. Rashi a. l.).
